sermon.title: Six of Seven Seals — Part 3
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In this third message on six of the seven seals, Pastor David G. Kincer finishes the sixth seal, connecting it to Joel in Acts 2:16, Matthew 24:29 and Isaiah 34:4. He then previews the seventh seal with the sealing of God’s servants in Revelation 7, teaches that believers are sealed by the Holy Spirit, and gives reasons for a delay in the second coming: the martyr number, the sealing, and the great harvest of the multitude no one could count.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added by hand, and obvious caption errors were corrected; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: the passage about the four angels and the seal of the living God (about 9:35) and the Ezekiel 9:4-6 reading (about 10:20) are read from a version other than NKJV and are partly paraphrased, so the NKJV text is shown separately; “bond of servants” was written as “bond servants.” One word is marked [unclear]: the group named before “have the seven seals as seven 1,000-year periods” (about 6:25). The captions read “hose” for “host” in Isaiah 34:4, and “ceiling” for “sealing.” His statements about the movement of Hawaii, Tahiti and a mountain (about 0:00), the lists of tribes in Revelation 7 (about 18:30), and the remarks on nations, religions and the Jehovah’s Witnesses (about 15:00–17:00 and about 19:00) are shown as he said them. In the Russia passage (about 15:20) the captions read “persecute the Jews because they’re born Russian,” which is written as captioned.

chunks.section_question: What does he say the sixth seal does to the earth, and why does everyone hide? (Revelation 6:14-17)
chunks.short_answer: He says, “Every mountain and island was dislodged, removed out of its place,” and ties it to the Bible’s promise that “He’s going to renovate the earth.” He says “everybody’s hiding. Why? They see Him.” He then challenges the rapture idea: “These people that say, you know, Jesus comes and raptures the church and people are wondering what happened. Well, good grief, even in your theory the graves were open and they’re wondering what happened.”

chunks.section_question: What do Acts 2:16 and Joel say about the last days? (Acts 2:16-21; Joel 2:28-32)

Prophesying and preaching the Word of God is going to happen to the day He comes.”
chunks.text:

On the day of Pentecost the Holy Ghost moved, and they spoke the wonderful works of God, they spoke in languages, and they were filled with power and everything else.

And the Bible says this is what the prophet Joel prophesied: “It will come to pass in the last days that I will pour out My Spirit on all flesh. Your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your young men will see visions, and your old men will dream dreams. On My servants and on My handmaidens I’ll pour out My Spirit, and they will prophesy. The sun shall be turned into darkness and the moon into blood before the great and notable day of the Lord. And it shall come to pass that whosoever shall call on the Lord shall be” what? Saved. Folks, He is saving people to the day He comes. Prophesying and preaching the Word of God is going to happen to the day He comes. Amen.

Now, you never hear preaching on that. It’s always 666, can’t buy and sell, 666, number of men, tick, tick, tick. We think Revelation was a revelation of 666. Well, here God seals His people, and He says delay everything. Say it: delay everything until I’m done sealing My people. Woo, woo.

chunks.section_question: What does it mean to be sealed by God, and does he say believers must be raptured out of tribulation? (Ephesians 1:13; 2 Corinthians 1:22)

chunks.text:
Are you there? Now, if God has given me a seal, I don’t have to be raptured out of the tribulation period. Man, I can handle it. Why? He’s sealed me. Amen. chunks.section_question: What does he say about predictions that Russia, China or others will attack, in light of Revelation 7:9?
chunks.short_answer: He says, “if He’s bringing people out of every nation, kind, and tribe, and tongue,” then of those who predict a nation will destroy Israel, “they’re picking on a nation that God wants to save.” He says, “He’s out to bring out a people for Himself out of all these nations,” and “He doesn’t dislike Russians because they’re Russians.”
chunks.text:
Okay, a multitude no one could number come out of great tribulation, out of every nation, kind, and tribe, tongue, and people, and “there stood before the throne and before the Lamb.” Now listen, if He’s bringing people out of every nation, kind, and tribe, and tongue, these people that said Russia’s going to come down and destroy Israel and blah, blah, blah, they’re picking on a nation that God wants to save. When they say China’s going to do it, and the, you know, the Muslims are going to do it, the Arabs and all that, they’re picking on a nation that God wants to save. He’s out to bring out a people for Himself out of all these nations.

Let’s stop picking this, let’s stop bringing this. You know, the symbol of Russia was the bear, and so it says over there in Ezekiel the bear, and so forth, so they connect the symbol with the, God didn’t need a symbol back there to tell us what the bear was. He didn’t need a symbol today that Russia has to tell us who the bear is. And He doesn’t dislike Russians because they’re Russians. You cannot judge of people to die and persecute the Jews because they’re born Russian. What if you were born in Russia? Would that be good news to you? You’re doomed to come down and be destroyed. Amen.

chunks.section_question: Who does he say the people in white robes are? (Revelation 7:11-14; John 16:33)
chunks.short_answer: He reads Revelation 7:13-14 about those “clothed in long white robes” who “have washed their robes and made them white in the” blood of the Lamb. He says, “these people came from earth, and they were made white by what? The blood of the Lamb, not the persecution, not the tribulation.” He says, “we don’t have to be raptured out, we can handle this thing,” and quotes Jesus, “In this world you will have” tribulation.
chunks.text:
Now these cried, saying, “Salvation to our God who is seated on the throne and to the Lamb.” Here they are worshiping again, and all the angels were standing around the throne and around the elders and the four living creatures, and they all fell prostrate before the throne and worship God. Here’s a lot of worship going on in Revelation, and they cried, “Blessing and glory and majesty and splendor and wisdom and thanksgiving and honor and power and might to our God forever and ever.” All right. Now, those people in white robes, this innumerable number of people that came out of the great tribulation. Verse 13 says one of the elders said to me, “Who are these clothed in long white robes, and from where have they come?” And I replied, “Sir, you know.” And he said to me, “These are they which have come out of the great tribulation, the great persecution, and have washed their robes and made them white in the” what? Blood of the Lamb.

Jesus said, “In this world you will have” what? Tribulation. How many found that out? You know, if you’re twenty years old, you find you’re in a world that’s got a lot of conflict and trouble in it, and you are one of your biggest sources of trouble, aren’t you? Yeah, the guy you look at in the mirror. So these people came from earth, and they were made white by what? The blood of the Lamb, not the persecution, not the tribulation. You see, we don’t have to be raptured out, we can handle this thing. Are you with me? Are you with me? And it says “a number of,” so the blood of the Lamb is going to bring a powerful lot of people into the kingdom of God. Hallelujah, and you’re one of them.

scriptures.text_nkjv: All the angels stood around the throne and the elders and the four living creatures, and fell on their faces before the throne and worshiped God, saying: “Amen! Blessing and glory and wisdom, Thanksgiving and honor and power and might, Be to our God forever and ever. Amen.”

Then one of the elders answered, saying to me, “Who are these arrayed in white robes, and where did they come from?” And I said to him, “Sir, you know.” So he said to me, “These are the ones who come out of the great tribulation, and washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
These things I have spoken to you, that in Me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation; but be of good cheer, I have overcome the world.”

chunks.section_question: What does he say about the 144,000 and the twelve tribes? (Revelation 7:4-8)
chunks.short_answer: He says, “He lists twelve tribes and 12,000 out of each one,” but “Joseph is listed as one of the twelve tribes,” Ephraim “is not even mentioned,” and “Dan, who was one of the original twelve tribes, is not mentioned.” He says, “it has nothing to do with anything,” and “there ain’t just 144,000 going to heaven like the Jehovah’s Witnesses said.” He says “there’s an innumerable group of people up there in heaven” and the twelve tribes “illustrate the sealing of God’s people.”
chunks.text: Now, going back to the sealed people. Say, well, you know, there’s 144,000 people sealed. Well, give me a break. He lists twelve tribes and 12,000 out of each one. The problem here is Joseph is listed as one of the twelve tribes, but if you know your Bible, there’s really thirteen tribes now, because Ephraim was picked to be one of Jacob’s children and be one of the tribes, and so Ephraim got the birthright and everything, and Ephraim is not even mentioned in these twelve tribes. Dan, who was one of the original twelve tribes, is not mentioned. Hello? Now, God is so confused He don’t even know the names of His tribes. No, because it has nothing to do with anything. There ain’t just 144,000 going to heaven like the Jehovah’s Witnesses said, they’re a bunch of baloney. There’s an innumerable group of people up there in heaven. Amen. And He’s just using these twelve tribes to illustrate the sealing of God’s people. Hallelujah. So is there a delay? Why? The martyr quota hasn’t been reached.

scriptures.text_nkjv: And I heard the number of those who were sealed. One hundred and forty-four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel were sealed: of the tribe of Judah twelve thousand were sealed; of the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand were sealed; of the tribe of Gad twelve thousand were sealed; of the tribe of Asher twelve thousand were sealed; of the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand were sealed; of the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand were sealed; of the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand were sealed; of the tribe of Levi twelve thousand were sealed; of the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand were sealed; of the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand were sealed; of the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand were sealed; of the tribe of Benjamin twelve thousand were sealed.

chunks.section_question: Why does he say we should want the harvest to come in before the Lord returns?
chunks.short_answer: He says, “if you’re one of these that’s praying, ‘Oh, come, Lord Jesus, get me out of this mess,’ you don’t see the harvest,” and urges, “Stop being selfish and let’s get the vision of the harvest.” He asks whether Jesus’ blood is “big enough to save billions of people,” and says “what God wants to do is way beyond our capabilities.” He concludes, “it’s not about the beast and the troubles and the seven years of tribulation. It’s about the conquering Jesus and the harvest that His blood has power to bring in.”
chunks.text:
God isn’t finished saving souls and sealing them, and the harvest hasn’t been brought in yet. Now, if you’re one of these that’s praying, “Oh, come, Lord Jesus, get me out of this mess,” you don’t see the harvest. If you put yourself in the shoes of someone in China that they won’t even allow him to hear the gospel, and it’s very hard to hear it, you wouldn’t want Him coming now. You would want to hear the gospel first, isn’t that right? Stop being selfish and let’s get the vision of the harvest. Hallelujah. Is the blood of Jesus, the sacrifice of Jesus, big enough to save billions of people in this last day? We got almost 7 billion people in this world.

You talk about a harvest, we have a potential harvest, and that’s why we need to fast and pray and seek God, because what God wants to do is way beyond our capabilities. We need Him to arise in us, we need Him to arise in the world and accomplish what He promised to accomplish. Amen. And the second coming is about the power of Jesus Christ, the revelation of Jesus Christ, and what He can do in the earth. It’s not about the beast and the troubles and the seven years of tribulation. It’s about the conquering Jesus and the harvest that His blood has power to bring in. Now, I don’t know about you, but that’s good news.

faqs.question: What does he say happens to mountains and islands in the sixth seal?
faqs.answer: He says, “Every mountain and island was dislodged, removed out of its place,” and “There’s a drastic change here, isn’t that right?”

faqs.question: What does he say about popular second-coming stories and books?
faqs.answer: He says, “this second coming thing is really given us a black eye in the world,” and “It’s made us look bad, we need to get this thing right.”

faqs.question: Which prophet does he say Acts 2:16 points to?
faqs.answer: He reads Acts 2:16, “This is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel,” and says it is what happened on the day of Pentecost.

faqs.question: Does he say the Bible mentions a seven-year tribulation?
faqs.answer: No. He says, “Nowhere in the Bible does it say there’s seven years of tribulation, nowhere. They have to manufacture it out of Daniel.”

faqs.question: Does he say each seal is a thousand-year period?
faqs.answer: No. He says, “The Bible doesn’t say each seal is a thousand-year period.”

faqs.question: What does he say about God dwelling in temples?
faqs.answer: He says, “the Bible plainly says God doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands.”

faqs.question: What does he say is delayed until God’s servants are sealed?
faqs.answer: He says, “Don’t do any destruction until the people of God are sealed by God,” and that God says, “delay everything until I’m done sealing My people.”

faqs.question: What does he say a seal from God guarantees?
faqs.answer: He says it is “a guarantee of what? That He will finish the good work He’s begun in us,” and “He guarantees me He will get me to my destiny.”

faqs.question: What two reasons does he first give for the delay?
faqs.answer: He says, “First we find the delay because of the martyr quota hasn’t been reached. Second, we find there’s a delay because the saints of God have got to be sealed.”

faqs.question: What does he say made the robes white?
faqs.answer: He says, “they were made white by what? The blood of the Lamb, not the persecution, not the tribulation.”

faqs.question: Does he say only 144,000 people go to heaven?
faqs.answer: No. He says, “there ain’t just 144,000 going to heaven,” and “there’s an innumerable group of people up there in heaven.”

faqs.question: What does he say about praying for Jesus to come and get us out of this mess?
faqs.answer: He says, “if you’re one of these that’s praying, ‘Oh, come, Lord Jesus, get me out of this mess,’ you don’t see the harvest,” and “Stop being selfish and let’s get the vision of the harvest.”
